g.text: A Secure Blood Supply Ecosystem with Decentralized Verification and Traceability (Hybrid Web3 Model)
• Tamper Detection: DB Hash vs Blockchain Hash
Frontend Stack: React 18 SPA • Vite • Axios • Ethers.js v6 • HTML5-QRCode
• Role Guard: Donor, Hospital, Admin Access
Backend Stack: Node.js (LTS) • Express.js • Ethers v6 • Bcrypt • JWT
• Full Legal Name, Phone Number, Email
Strict Rule: Zero PII ever touches Blockchain
• Storage Shelf Location, Base64 QR URL
Immutable: Cannot be altered or deleted
Sensitive donor PII is kept strictly off-chain
Public verification calls require zero gas fees
Keccak-256 fingerprints anchored permanently on EVM
